note: Intraday trading minutes per source|market, in exchange-local minute-of-day of the WAL partition's calendar date (session_identity_contract: trading_date = exchange calendar date). Intervals are inclusive minute STARTS. `print_instants` are exchange-local minutes outside the intervals at whose first second (hh:mm:00) the venue stamps a single match or publication, not trading minutes (no bar of their own, no clock): TW stocks 13:33 (delayed closing match) and 14:30 (盤後定價 match), TW indices 13:33 (the published closing index); an outage touching one is a trading outage (native/market_runtime/src/evidence.rs). A session's first print instant after its last interval is its closing publication and closes that last trading minute's bar (Calendar::bar_minute); a later one (14:30) has no bar. A business session is one continuous accumulation scope: recent windows never bridge two sessions; breaks inside a session (lunch) are non-trading minutes, not missing data. `continues_previous_day` joins a session tail after midnight to the previous calendar partition's session of the same name. Holidays need no entry: no data, no clock scope, no minutes. shioaji|FUT is partitioned per business session (2026-10-01): a DAY partition holds 08:45-13:45 of its date; a NIGHT partition is dated by the day it opens and its minutes continue past midnight (00:00 = 1440, 05:00 = 1740). futu|US has the 24-hour overnight session (20:00-03:59 New York, 2026-10-08): 20:00-23:59 of a date, then 00:00-03:59 of the next date's partition continuing it. `half_day_intervals`: a session's trading minutes on an exchange half day (US half days, config/market_holidays.json NYSE `half` or OpenD's MORNING days: the regular session closes at 13:00 and the after-hours session runs 13:00-17:00).
